why: The three September 2026 events each claim a counterexample. Krempa and Sands showed decades ago that the matrix form is equivalent to Köthe's conjecture, so refuting the matrix form refutes the statement as worded. A refutation of a universal statement answers all of it, so all three are scope whole. All three are unreviewed. The Lean build proves only the formal statement (F7). The 2609.07996 checkers are its own co-authors, and nobody outside read either preprint in 5 weeks. Nothing specific counts against them, so they stay credible. AI role: the Lean disproof was found autonomously by GPT-6 Astra, so generated. In 2609.07996, people extended the AI's initial construction to every countable field and to Rowen's question, so assisted. This was a close call against generated, and step 4 makes it immaterial. GKV is assisted because the model supplied the main argument of Lemma 4.2. Goodson-Taylor gives a new proof of a known class result, so none. The 2024–2025 items are reformulations or restricted cases.
doubts: The step from the two-sided matrix form to the one-sided wording rests on the classical Krempa/Sands equivalence, not on a formal check. Both preprints were read only through HTML excerpts. The 2024–2025 items were not read.
